chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Straightening the chronology: Pathe, Canada and the 1926 contract trouble
summary: He lays out Pathe in 1921-22, then New York, Canada, the Loew's circuit and contract trouble around 1925-26.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: Yeah, in New York. I had a family in New York, took time to get them there but from where they came, where I brought them from. Can we get back to when I was working in Chicago. That little place I want to clear up for you in Chicago. It was in the year 1926 from the Pathe' studio in California in the year of 1921 and '22 was good, but after that we went into New York and
after New York we went to Canada and from Canada we went again to the Loews circuit throughout New York. Then we had the difficulty with the contract in the year of 1926 and '25.
